sources.label: ADJ Vertigo Tri LED product page and user manual
sources.scope: Official page (discontinued product): 2 × 9 W 3-in-1 RGB TRI LEDs, 32 sound-activated beams, 30 W, 100–240 V, IEC in/out for daisy-chaining, 345 × 290 × 272 mm (L × W × H), 3.3 kg. Manual link assets.centryngroup.com/dl/files/VERTIGO_TRI_LED__DL__001.pdf could not be machine-read.

sources.label: NNC gear record
sources.scope: Unit identity, quantity, and retailer-reproduced figures where the manufacturer page no longer carries them.

sources.label: NNC equipment inventory
sources.scope: Which units NNC owns and how many.

components.label: Fixture body and bracket
components.purpose: Twin-dome LED effect, 345 × 290 × 272 mm (L × W × H) and 3.3 kg, on a hanging bracket. Two in the inventory.
components.limits: Envelope is published; dome and bracket shapes are approximate.

components.label: Left lens dome
components.purpose: One of two domes, each over a 9 W 3-in-1 RGB LED, together throwing 32 sound-activated moving and strobing beams.

components.label: Right lens dome
components.purpose: Second dome; colours listed are red, green, blue, purple, yellow, cyan and white.

components.label: IEC power in and out
components.purpose: IEC inlet and outlet for daisy-chaining power, 100–240 V 50/60 Hz, 30 W per unit (32 W on the EU listing).

components.label: Sound-active control
components.purpose: Sound activation is the only mode on the product page; no DMX channel count is published.
components.limits: The manual could not be machine-read; a sensitivity knob is not confirmed.

evidence_policy.physical_verification: None; no dimension or placement has been checked against a physical unit
